posts.author: AJ Pryor
posts.body:
When the fight becomes something more...

#WIPSnips #WriteSky #WritingCommunity

images.alt:
As an Ethereal, Ed had been taught how to fight. The order and the control. The predictability. The patterns. It made sense. And he was good at it. 
Even, as Rina called it, missing a wing. 
All of which helped him not at all, as Hannah landed a blow to his jaw that had him seeing stars. He shook his head to clear it, darted back out of her range, and came in swinging. Hard. 
Her “oof” as his fist connected with her abdomen had him grinning and her snarling. 
“Feeling me yet, princess?”
“I wouldn’t feel you if you were the last man in the Folly.”
He feinted right, ducked under her guard and managed to get behind her and wrap his arm around her neck in a choke. Which admittedly would have been more effective with two arms, as a second later he found himself flying as she tossed him over her shoulder in a well-practiced judo throw.
He rolled without thinking and her follow-up stomp hit the mat instead of him. She hobbled back and he jumped up to his feet.
They fought without tactics, without the precision he’d come to expect from her. And damn him if it wasn’t… arousing.
That thought crawling into his skull slammed all brakes on, which was the only reason her uppercut connected and knocked his head back.

#OTD in 1944, Thomas Akio Hoshino is fined and sentenced to three years and three months in federal prison for failing to report to induction into the Army. Hoshino and 33 other Nisei men from Minidoka were convicted for draft evasion. 
🗃 #skystorians #OTD

images.alt:
"Seattle Jap Draft Evader Sentenced"

BOISE. Idaho, Sept. 28.--(AP)- United States District Judge Chase A. Clark today sentenced Thomas Akio Hoshino, 25 years old, Seattle to pay a $300 fine. and serve three years and three months in a federal penitentiary for failure to report for Selective Service induction.
Hoshino was one of 34 Nisei from the Minidoka Relocation Center Hunt, Idaho, convicted or pleading guilty to draft violations. One was acquitted.

The Seattle Times, September 28, 1944

posts.body:
1hr doodle redeems for @velius1313.bsky.social 's Pumpkin, and @yaminido.bsky.social , who asked me to draw my Tayhu!

#PixelArt

images.alt:
1 hour pixel art doode of Velius' OC, Pumpkin

She's a dark skinned catgirl with dark brown hair, ears and a tail, brown skin and emerald green eyes. She wears a pink scarf/collar with a bell, a tan t-shirt with rustic red overalls with baggy pants that have thin stripes, a couple of gray belts, and she normally wears brown boots but in this shot she is barefoot don't judge me.

She's shown squatting, on her toes and leaning forward a bit, resting on top of her knees with both arms extended forward. She's giving a somewhat bored side glance away from the camera.

1 hour pixel art doodle of my raven witch OC, Tayhu!

She's a short and petite raven woman with dark olive hair styled in a jellyfish haircut, fair skin, purplish red eyes with slight eyebags, feathery ears, and a pair of relatively small dark wings, with the left one being droopy.

She wears a skin tight mesh top with a slit just below the chest, a cross halter on top, and a necklace with green gems.
The bottom of the attire is a layered shin length skirt and drapes, and a belt made out of big coin like artifacts with green treads attached to some of them.

This is a perspective shot of her from above, and she's looking up directly at the camera with a tired but happy expression and is holding a cup of water in her right hand.

images.alt: A black-and-white engraved illustration shows a large, bearded humanoid figure seated or standing in the center, surrounded by numerous much smaller people. The figure wears a tall, pointed cap, a broad layered garment decorated with rows of circular trim, and a sunburst-like hem at the bottom. Its face has prominent eyes, a long nose, a mustache, and a full beard. Several curving, handwritten-looking marks appear on the figure’s lower garment. Crowds of robed or formally dressed people fill the sloping terrain on both sides and gather around the figure’s base. Draped fabric or a canopy extends across the upper background, while heavily crosshatched lines create texture throughout the scene.

A black-and-white engraved print presents two religious scenes within an ornate rectangular border. A heading appears above the scenes, and explanatory captions are printed below.

In the left panel, a large multi-armed figure identified in the caption as Amida stands on a pedestal. The figure wears a tall pointed headdress, layered robes, necklaces, and a large circular ornament around the lower body. Numerous small worshippers kneel or stand in rows around the figure. Draped fabric hangs overhead, and a large blank rectangular panel and smoking vessels appear near the bottom.

In the right panel, a seated figure identified as Confucius appears on a raised platform, surrounded by several robed attendants or worshippers. The central figure wears a tall, patterned headdress and a sash marked with characters. Hanging panels with vertical inscriptions and small suspended objects fill the background. Several people gather on the stepped platform below, with tall incense burners emitting smoke.

posts.author: Kev Abazajian
posts.body:
1/ Can the shape of the Galactic Center gamma-ray excess tell dark matter from old stars? Yes. A recent PRL found them alike in sims, but squared the projected mass instead of integrating ρ². Corrected, annihilation is more centrally concentrated. arxiv.org/abs/2609.34155
⚛️ 🔭 🧪 #highenergyastro

images.alt:
Grid of 30 simulated gamma-ray sky maps of the Milky Way's central region, 6 rows by 5 columns, each spanning about ±15° in longitude and latitude. Each row is a different simulated Milky Way–like galaxy. Colors run from blue (faint) to red (bright), with three contour lines per map.

Columns 1–3 follow the method of the earlier paper: dark matter mass projection, old-star mass projection, and the squared dark matter mass ("quadratic DM"). Columns 4–5 show the corrected calculations: old-star emission and dark matter annihilation.

Columns 1 and 3 have identically shaped contours in every row. In columns 2 and 4, the old-star emission forms wide, flattened ovals, strongly elongated in the barred galaxy of the third row. In column 5, the correctly computed dark matter annihilation is a compact, rounder bright spot that is much more concentrated toward the center than the stellar emission in every galaxy.

Small tables in each panel list contour levels and axis ratios.

images.alt:
And now, I just tell the police the prepared lie:

It’s just a game we were playing. 
He loves this kind of thing, Officer, pretending. 
It was pretending to be a spy last month. 
This week it was to be kidnapped. 
Call him. He's okay!

Look, officers, here's his signature agreeing to everything. 

Well, my pretty near-perfect version of it.

Oh my God, I am so sorry to have wasted your time! No, his friends weren't aware. 
I feel stupid. 
Yes, I should have told them.
I feel awful for wasting your time. 
He's absolutely fine. 
Let me make a donation to your widows’ fund. 

Something like that. Right?

posts.author: Surprised Eel Historian, PhD
posts.body:
It's Monday! Let's start week off with a map & some eels!

Here is John Speed's 1611 map, "The Kingdome of Great Britaine and Ireland."  There are Dutch eel ships on this map. Can you find them? (the answer is at the end of the thread)

Wait, you ask...WTF is an eel ship? 1/5
🗃️🧪

images.alt:
A map of of England, Wales, Scotland, and Ireland. It is quite busy with roads, and towns, and counties. There are monsters in the sea, and several ships. There are 2 large insets, one showing the a view of the city of London and one showing the city of Edinburgh. There is a smaller inset above the Edinburgh one showing the northern tip of Scotland and the Orkneys. Above the inset for London is the coat of arms for the Order of the Garter, with a lion and unicorn. The arms have the order's motto around them: "honi soit qui mal y pense" (shame on him that thinks ill of it), and below it the popular Puritan phrase, "Semper Idem" (always the same). It is a very detailed and pretty map.

"Always the same" and "shame on him that thinks ill of it" is strident rejection of the Growth Mindset ideology, and I am here for it.

images.alt:
Flyer for a University of Alaska Fairbanks College of Fisheries and Ocean Sciences seminar reads:

Please join us for a seminar with Dr. Yoshitaka Ota. Thursday, October 1st, 3:40-4:40pm (Alaska time). In-person in Anchorage 1007 W 3rd Ave, Suite 100 or watch parties in Fairbanks Troth Yeddha' O'Neill 201 and Juneau -  Lena 101 or register in advance by Zoom

Title: What is Ocean Equity?

Abstract: Despite the development of various equity frameworks and indicators, there remain concerns about the potential for co-optation embedded in indicators and enablers that largely focus on equality while paying insufficient attention to power relations and the historical and systemic nature of ocean governance. The talk will argue that unpacking these systemic structures requires intentionally departing from conventional views of equity and engaging more deeply with social justice scholarship.

Host: https://www.tamamta.org/general-7

posts.body:
Sex workers face massive physical and mental health challenges. Could any intervention help with that? Education and empowerment as peer delivery one help. But generally, they mostly need better access to appropriate care. 🧪

Link: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2468266722002523​

images.alt:
Harvest plot of evidence for interventions to improve health and wider determinants in sex workers by intervention category

The harvest plot is a supermatrix showing the direction of effect for outcome categories across different categories of intervention. Each bar represents an intervention and is labelled by a footnote, which can be identified below. Taller bars represent interventions from studies with a moderate-quality assessment; shorter bars are interventions from studies with a low-quality assessment. Darker purple bars are static interventions. Lighter purple bars are outreach. Striped bars are interventions that involved peer design, delivery, or both. Solid bars had no peer involvement.

Flyer for the Strait Science Seminar from the University of Alaska Fairbanks Northwest Campus Alaska Sea Grant office reads:

Join us via ZOOM for the next presentation in our Strait Science series…

MERCURY CONCENTRATIONS IN NORTHERN FUR SEALS OF THE BERING SEA

Thursday, October 1 | 6:30 pm | VIA ZOOM

Mercury (natural and/or manmade) is a heavy metal that exists in the marine food web.  Mercury can accumulate in long-lived wildlife - important for human consumption. Orlin will share results of his research on mercury levels in adult female fur seals from the Pribilof Islands. Come hear his plans to research mercury levels in subsistence seafoods from Nome and Savoonga. 

Join Zoom Meeting

images.alt:
“I won!”
It was childish of her, she knew that. But Sera did so like to win. She made an attempt at calming herself down but needlessly, as Neu stood to his feet with a wide smile and a demure round of applause. He came around the unit towards her.
“Well done!” he said. “I can hardly believe it, but well done! You must have…”
Drawing close, he leaned around the divider and examined her win-state. Sera could smell the minty shampoo he used in his gorgeous locks.
“Oh, you little devil!” he laughed. “You were right beside me the whole time! Very sneaky!”
Sera felt herself blushing, and the rushing warmth of the heavy effects of her drink. She rested herself down into a seat on the tabletop of the unit, and Neu came to a seat beside her. Close. He liked to be close, her Neu.

images.alt:
“Is this an emergency?” Rune asked, raising one brow.
“Oh, I think it is! If I don’t hear how Marcus has been treating you between the sheets, I think I might just die!”
A feline technician happened to be walking by at that moment, and she turned curiously to eavesdrop until she passed them by. Rune blushed fiercely.
“Y-You already know all about that.”
“Do I? Let’s find out.” Therese’s tentacle reached around, tugging Rune closer beside her, and the tip tapped on the glass of the wine bottle with a pleasantly full thunk. “Drink that, and then tell me there’s nothing left for me to discover.”
“A-All of it?”
“Half of it. And who knows.” Therese nuzzled Rune’s hair playfully. “Maybe once I’m properly lubricated with the other half, I’ll let you tease me a bit, too.”
This time, more people were passing by, and they all turned to listen.

posts.author: Journal of Experimental Botany
posts.body:
🌾🧬 REVIEW 🧬🌾

Neupane et al. review challenges to functional interpretation of rice WRKY TFs, including multifunctionality, redundancy, context dependency, and complex regulation, and outline emerging strategies to solving those challenges.

🔗 doi.org/10.1093/jxb/...

#PlantScience 🧪

images.alt: Fig. 1.Classification and conserved domain structure of the WRKY TF family in rice [modified from X. Chen et al. (2019)]. The WRKY family is divided into three major groups, with Group II and III further subdivided based on the type of their WRKY domains and zinc-finger motifs. Group I proteins contain two WRKY domains (NT: N-terminal and CT: C-terminal) followed by a C2H2-type zinc-finger motif. Group II proteins contain a single WRKY domain followed by a C2H2-type motif. Group III proteins contain a single WRKY domain and C2HC-type zinc finger motif. Green boxes indicate the conserved WRKY heptapeptide, while the orange boxes show the zinc-finger motifs (C, cysteine; H, histidine; N, asparagine; R, arginine; T, threonine; X, any amino acid). Dashed lines and associated numbers indicate variable regions between motifs, highlighting structural diversity within the family. Created in BioRender. Neupane, K. (2026) https://BioRender.com/ro50ved.

Can you #FindThatLizard?! 🦎

Lizards pant to cool themselves off when temperatures get too high!

All animals need ways to cool down, lizards included, because they can overheat. Humans sweat, birds bathe or swim, and pigs roll in mud. So it makes sense that lizards would have a cooling strategy.

SLOPPY JOES

Heat in a skillet:
2 tablespoons butter
Add and sauté:
½ cup minced onions
½ cup chopped celery
½ cup chopped green pepper, seeds and membrane removed
When these are limp, add:
1½ Ib. ground beef
Cook and stir until meat is lightly browned. Add:
½ cup chopped mushrooms
4 tablespoons chili sauce
½ cup water
Season to taste
Simmer uncovered over low heat about 15 minutes until thickened enough to spoon onto:

8 slightly toasted sandwich buns

posts.author: Journal of Experimental Botany
posts.body:
🍐🧬 RESEARCH 🧬🍐

A cross-species protoplast isolation system for woody plants is developed alongside a DNA-free CRISPR/Cas9 multiplex editing platform for Pyrus, enabling rapid trait analysis and transgene-free precision breeding - Shao et al.

🔗 doi.org/10.1093/jxb/...

#PlantScience 🧪

images.alt: Fig. 1 (shortened, full legend in paper): A streamlined and efficient protoplast-based method for transgene-free genome editing and rapid gene functional analysis in woody perennials. (A) Outline of the optimization process of enzymatic hydrolysis conditions to yield high-purity and high-viability protoplasts across diverse woody species. (B) PEG–Ca2+-mediated delivery of plasmids and Cas9-single-guide RNA ribonucleoproteins to achieve overexpression or DNA-free efficient editing. (C–E) Multi-dimensional functional validation across different woody plant genera. The system facilitates a comprehensive analysis pipeline, including: (C) real-time subcellular localization and phenotypic analysis using high-resolution confocal imaging technology; (D) evaluation of editing efficiency and identification of mutation types through high-throughput sequencing; and (E) quantitative transcriptional analysis to investigate gene expression patterns and downstream regulatory networks.

images.alt:
A Blue Tit perched on a bare branch in the bright sunshine. The bird is slightly left of centre of the frame, perched on a thin, horizontal branch with its body facing to the right so its right side is visible. Its head is turned towards the camera and its crest is up.
The bird has a bright blue crown, white cheeks split by dark eye stripe and a dark patch under its small thin beak. Its back is green and its wings and tail are blue. Its underside is a lemon yellow and its legs are a bluish grey. 
The bird is on a thin branch running along the bottom of the shot. A larger, lichen covered branch is behind it, travelling from the bottom left of the shot to almost the centre of the top. Another branch crosses the top right corner. 
The background is out focus, lightly coloured to the left of the shot and dark on the right.

There are 332 instances of ‘well’—you’ll excuse me if I don’t go through them all looking for the ‘best’.
#books #writing #WriteSky #writingcommunity

images.alt:
It was clear that Jerya’s name meant something to her, and didn’t take long to clarify the relationships; Meladne technically Jerya’s step-mother, Tegwen her half-sister, Manaili her niece. The link was Holdren, father to one, grandfather to the other. That Torvyn was her cousin was straightforward too.
Well, family relationships weren’t that different either side of the divide—at least until you ran up against the whole business of Earls and Countesses, not to mention Dowager Countesses, Principals, Electors…

images.alt:
Two flowering heads of Allium
schoenoprasum (chives) rise above dense
green grass and foliage. The rounded flower heads are composed of many delicate, narrow, pale lilac-pink florets, with the right-hand bloom slightly larger and more fully open. Fine hairs and tiny water droplets are visible on a diagonal stem in the foreground. Warm sunlight highlights the flowers and fresh green vegetation.

posts.author: Nana's CookBooks
posts.body: When I opened Nana's 1943 cookbook, it must have known that I had some leftover roast that needed to be used up. This Beef Hash looks quick and I happen to have all the ingredients & more. So dinner's on my tonight, Nana. 😀 🍽️ 🍜 #FoodSky #Cooking #Recipes #RecipeOfTheDay

images.alt:
From 1943,  The Modern Family Cookbook by Meta Givens

BEEF HASH No. 2
2 medium onions, sliced
2 cups diced left-over beef roast or pot roast
2 tablespoons bacon drippings
4 medium-sized cooked potatoes
Milk
Salt and pepper to suit taste

Sauté onions in bacon drippings until soft. Add potatoes, cut in small dice, and beef; add just enough milk to moisten, and seasonings. Mix well, cover skillet and simmer until under side of hash is well browned.
Slide hash onto a hot platter and garnish with parsley. 5 servings.

posts.body: I got tired of reading my linker configuration file manually, so I built a quick visualizer to see how much space I have left in each bank. Every pixel is one byte of the final program, separated into PRG (code and data) up top, and CHR (graphics tiles) down below. Roomy, for now! #nes #gamedev

images.alt: An enormous grid of squares. Many are one solid color, indicating an empty bank (lazy artist, draw faster!) but many more are full of what appears to be noise. These are bytes of the program (top) and 2bpp representations of the graphics tiles (below) respectively. At a glance, a bit over half of the space seems to be used in both regions.

posts.author: Nereide
posts.body:
Think you know Jupiter? In ultraviolet light, it can look like almost another planet.

Dark poles, a dark Great Red Spot, one bright oval that fades.

#Hubble reveals clouds and hazes the eye cannot see.

📷NASA, ESA, Hubble, Judy Schmidt

apod.nasa.gov/apod/ap18101...

🧪🔭⚛️ #planetsci #astronomy

images.alt:
Jupiter sits big and round against black. This is near-ultraviolet, false color.
Bands run across the disk in cyan, pink and muted brown instead of the usual cream and orange. The poles look darker  brown with slightly pinkish clues. On the left side of the planet a large storm, the Great Red Spot, is also dark rather than red. Just to its right a smaller oval that would look white in visible light is similarly dark. Farther right a chain of storms, the String of Pearls, stands out bright pink.A small round disk at upper left, off the planet’s limb, is Ganymede.
A thin credit line at lower right reads NASA, ESA, Hubble, Processing: Judy Schmidt.

posts.author: mona
posts.body:
The Well. Where all things began, or perhaps, where they ended.

#WriteSky #WritingCommunity #WritingPrompts

images.alt:
I would have heard it for the first time when I was pulled from the waters of the well. It was only ever known as a well to me, but it wasn't made of stacked stone, or pumped by an iron handle, as the ones I think to now. Our well was simply a shallow pool within a grove of trees. There was no path there but for the one worn down into dark, smooth clay by our feet. The water was ice cold, fed from deep underground, and in Autumn, stained umber by the leaves falling within.
It would have been spoken over me there, as names were spoken over countless other boys being given to the Mothers. Some of them thrashed beneath the surface until foam clustered at the edges. Others were lowered in the same way they were lifted out - stricken and staring - with the water turning to glass between. 
I have no way of knowing what my body did in that moment. I don't remember it, or the sound of my name on the other side. All I really remember are the bony hands gripping my limbs, the shape of children huddled, watching at the bank, and the wavering white of the moon, glimpsed from underneath

A loop of four numbered stations circles the centre. 1, Grow: a laser plume over a substrate. 2, Stop: a falling reflectivity trace cut at 1 monolayer. 3, Score: a sharp Raman peak, labelled Raman peak sharpness. 4, Choose: a model curve with its peak marked, labelled next recipe. posts.author: Journal of Experimental Botany
posts.body:
🫛☀️ FLOWERING NEWSLETTER REVIEW ☀️🫛

In this review, Henriques & Benlloch explore how photoperiod-dependent flowering in legumes relies on the coordinated action of conserved (e.g. phyA) and specific (e.g. E1 proteins) molecular regulators 🧬

🔗 doi.org/10.1093/jxb/...

#PlantScience 🧪

images.alt: Fig. 2 (shortened, full legend in paper): Role of phyA in photoperiodic flowering in Genistoid, Galegoid, and Phaseoloid legumes. (A) phyA function in Genistoid legumes (lupins) is poorly characterized and whether they act as floral promoters or repressors and their relationship to the lupin E1 proteins remains to be elucidated. (B) In LD Galegoid legumes (pea and Medicago), phyA acts as a flowering promoter, activating (directly or indirectly) the expression of GI, FT genes, and E1L. (C) In SD Phaseoloid species (soybean), phyA represses flowering by: (i) interacting with LUX and activating E1, E1La, and E1Lb expression; (ii) stabilizing E1, E1La, and E1Lb proteins; and (iii) directly binding and repressing FT genes. This model reflects information available in soybean, where more detailed molecular studies have been carried out.

If a "climate tech" company is pivoting to servicing the needs of a generative AI industry that specifically hungers for fossil fuels, how on Earth is that still "climate tech"? 

That is petrotech - and we should call it that, when it is that. 

techcrunch.com/2026/09/28/t...

images.alt: The pivot has helped many climate tech startups land fresh funding from investors. Total venture deal value has risen for four consecutive quarters, cresting the $14 billion-mark in the first quarter of this year, according to the most recent available data from PitchBook. It’s the best fundraising environment for climate tech in the last few years, with most of the deal value driven by sectors boosted by data center construction, including the built environment, grid infrastructure, and dispatchable energy that can be turned on or off when it’s needed.

Ultimately, the undercurrent at New York Climate Week was that the data center party won’t last forever, but it might last long enough to help startups build durable businesses. Once that happens, they can refocus on the carbon-cutting mission they were founded to pursue.

images.alt:
A close-up photograph of lovely Eastern Redbud blossoms in full spring bloom. Delicate pink and purple flowers cluster directly along a textured gray branch, a signature trait of the redbud tree, whose blossoms burst straight from the bark before its leaves appear. Each petite, pea-shaped flower opens in soft layers of pale pink and deeper magenta, while plump, rosy flower buds wait their turn to unfurl. Slender reddish stems hold the blooms out from the rough, weathered bark, creating a striking contrast between the tree's rugged branch and its tender blossoms. The background melts into a soft, blurred wash of green garden foliage, making this spring flower photograph feel fresh, peaceful, and full of seasonal color.

images.alt:
From 1943, The Modern Family Cookbook by Meta Givens

SPLIT PEA SOUP
½ ham bone
1 cup green split peas, soaked 2 hours in 1 cup water
1 quart water
1 bay leaf
1 medium tomato, peeled, or ½ cup canned tomatoes
1/8 teaspoon celery seed
Pinch of thyme, if desired
1 2/3 cups evaporated milk

Use bone from which practically all meat has been removed. Crack bone and put into soup kettle; add water, seasonings, soaked peas and tomato. Cover and simmer about 2 hours. Remove bone and strain soup, pressing peas through the sieve. Stir in the evaporated milk and re-heat.
If desired, thicken by adding 2 teaspoons flour blended to a smooth paste with cold water, and continue stirring until soup comes to a boil. Serve steaming hot. 5 generous servings.

images.alt:
He splintered into pieces of flashing steel.
About him, cacophony and chaos spiraled and he within it, not steel bits himself, he now saw, but surrounded by them, and all else smeared with blood. 
Above the battle, a black shadow heaved itself upward on heavy, articulated wings. Its neck snaked
forward, sinews bulging like Silverbark roots from a body armored with volcanic boulders. Its mouth opened, vast and fiery. The earth cracked under its appalling screech, and a deeper, still more dreadful wailing arced from elsewhere across a dark sky
ribboned with crimson rents. He knew that scream, or would know it, issuing from a WELL of anguish as deep as the Nethernight itself: his own voice, or that of some other. He dropped his longsword.

Brother's Keeper
A.C. Turek

images.alt:
It was like seeing a place in the daytime that had been terrifying at night, and now you realized it was a completely normal, boring place.

Claire remembered when she was little, and scared by the strange, shapeless shadows that filled her room every night. Her mother had told her, this is just what the dark does, but it's still the same room as it was in the daylight. This made Claire feel a little better.

Then Dad told her about how when *he* was a little boy, every night he saw a row of mysterious hooded figures standing in the closet, watching, waiting, their faces hidden in their hoods. And then every morning they turned out to be only a bunch of short sleeve shirts hanging in the closet. Their hoods were the sleeves. *This* had not made Claire feel better at all.

*I need to tell Myst about that one,* Claire said to herself.

images.alt:
From 1965,  The Fannie Farmer Cookbook

Honey Bread
(Spice Bread; Pain d'Épice)
Long beating makes the fine texture which distinguishes this bread, the famous French pain d'épice. Add 1 tablespoon rum to the mixture, if you like.
Cut in thin slices, spread with unsalted butter, and serve with tea or coffee.

Sift into a mixing bowl
   2 cups all-purpose flour or half rye flour
   1 teaspoon baking powder
   1 teaspoon baking soda
   1 teaspoon salt 
   ½ teaspoon cinnamon
   1 teaspoon ginger
Add
   ½ cup strained honey
   1 egg, slightly beaten
   1 cup milk
Beat thoroughly, 15 minutes at the very least. If you have an electric beater, beat ½ hour. Spoon into a buttered loaf pan 9 by 5 inches, or into bread stick pans.
Bake at 350°, about 50 minutes for a loaf, 25 for bread sticks.

images.alt: This photo shows Witmer holding up a 3D print of a T. rex braincase (AMNH 5117), surrounded by OU Geology Club members. Thanks to Evan Doles & Abbie Fausnaugh for the photos!

This photo shows Witmer holding up a large photo of the T. rex holotype (CM 9380) skeleton snapped in the exhibits at the Carnegie Museum, as members of OU Geology Club members look on. At the time we were discussing what it means to be a "holotype specimen." Tyrannosaur skull casts dominate the foreground. Thanks to Evan Doles & Abbie Fausnaugh for the photos!
This photo shows Witmer giving an introduction about research in our lab to members of OU Geology Club. Thanks to Evan Doles & Abbie Fausnaugh for the photos!

This photo shows us in our prep lab where we do lots of dissections of carcasses of modern-day animals that have been donated to us for research. Witmer stand next to tables on which are laid out large skeletons of an alligator and a crocodile, as well as a set of anhinga wings. Thanks to Evan Doles & Abbie Fausnaugh for the photos!

The night’s sleep and the priests’ healing had apparently left him with a little more energy that he’d had the night before, because he only waited a moment before he said, “Where are you going?”
	I realized I’d already shifted to roll off my cot; well, his hearing and his brain were still sharp.  “I’m going to keep looking for Torvandin, sir.  Unless you want me to stay here with you.”
	He either considered that or just fought to stay awake, then asked, “Where are you looking?”
	I went ahead and climbed to the floor, lifting my sword off my cot as I did.  “The Grekaan are rich, well-connected people, and they must have servants who will know things. As he began to leave, a million different questions raced to my lips, all struggling to be heard. But only one squeaked through. “What about my statement?”

Isaac stopped, his hand already grasping the handle of the door. I could see little of his face as he stared towards his exit, but through strands of his long gray hair, the wide venomous grin that spread across his lips was clear as day. 

His voice rang low, yet strong with a dark finality. “There is no need. I’ve already written your lines, saving you the trouble of speaking them.” He gently swung open the door. “Goodbye, Jane Sothara. You will be missed.”

images.alt:
‘Do you think he’s going to fuck Albie?’

‘I would imagine so.’

‘Does that mean you think he’ll claim him?’

‘Not necessarily. We have assumed he’ll fuck all of them, probably within the week.’

‘Why so sure?’

‘Well, it’s Piper. We’ve made it so the boys have to ask him, but he’s hot, and charming, and has a cute accent, so they probably will. Once he’s fucked one of them, which we can probably assume is happening now, either all the others will back off or it will turn into the hunger games.’

‘With you and Tank training him, I can’t see them backing off. Hot Doms who know what they’re doing aren’t as common as they should be.’

‘So, you do think Piper’s hot.’

‘He’s pretty to look at, and the accent is cute. I think he’d be a fun friend. He’s not my type though.’

‘Interesting. Why?’

‘Too aware of his own attractiveness, and he feels kind of chaotic.’

‘Thank you. Good boy.’

‘Are you worried he’ll try something with me? You’ve never warned anyone off before. I liked that a lot.’

‘I bet you did, brat. No. The warning was just routine. I could be wrong, but I believe even the old version of Piper wouldn’t have been stupid enough to cross me.’

‘I still like that you can be dangerous. I know you don’t like that, but it’s hot. I’m so safe.’

‘I’m not sure what to do with that, but you are definitely safe.’ 

Leo might think the potential for danger was hot, but I would do everything in my power to make sure he never got to see what I was actually capable of. In our youth, Tank and I had become involved in several situations I suspected would terrify my boy rather than turning him on. He was also correct about how safe he was, because I would never allow him near one of those situations.

posts.author: Silas Summers 🔞
posts.body:
#WIPSnips - September 29, 2026

Andrew just made a proposition to his best friend, Aaron. Aaron doesn't know how to handle this request.

#TheRomanticTalesSeries #OwnVoice #WritingCommunity

images.alt:
“Aaron? Are you awake?”

 His voice gently wakes me up, I look over from my sleeping position on my back, he is looking at me as he is propped up on an elbow. He looks like he just had a ‘come to Jesus moment’. “Kind of, what time is it?”

 “It’s three in the morning. I had an idea, but before you answer … hear me out, completely. No interjecting with your thoughts half way through.” He gives me this look he’s been giving me since we were kids, the look like I am about to argue with him, but he knows me pretty well.

 I roll my eyes but sit up, “Fine. I will shut my big fucking mouth until you’re done. But, you know I hate when you start off a conversation like that.”

 He sits up as well, “Yeah yeah. You know what you do, don’t make me say it out loud.” He turns to look at me, sitting crossed-legged on the bed. “What if, instead of trying to cancel this honeymoon and shit… you come with me instead?”

 My eyes are now fully open as I stare at him, trying to process what exactly was happening, what he was asking. I sat there for a few minutes, my brain trying to figure out the proper thing to say without sounding like a crazy person.

Coffee Cookies
Also delicious without the nuts.

Butter a cooky sheet. Set the oven at 350°
Cream together until very light
   ½ cup shortening
   2/3 cup sugar
   2 tablespoons instant coffee
Add
   1 egg, slightly beaten
   ¾ cup flour
   ¼ teaspoon salt
   ½ teaspoon vanilla
   ½ cup chopped nuts
Mix well. Put on the cooky sheet by tea-spoonfuls. Bake until the edges are firm and the tops dry (about 12 minutes). Remove from the tin immediately. Makes about 36.

posts.author: rachels_memories on AO3
posts.body:
#WriteSky #WritingCommunity #WritingPrompts #WIPSnips #traumamakesdrama

‘Well’ in Scene of the Crime

images.alt:
What ought a newly minted school governor to do when confronted with staff so obviously — unwell? I did what any school governor, or any friend — even an *estranged* friend — would do.
I spiked his drink.
In his defense, he didn't look that bad. He didn't look bad at all. He'd filled out since our 'estrangement.' It had been years, almost a decade, since he'd spurned me. I know, I know, he had his reasons. In those years, though, he'd cultivated his look — all black everything — plus his brooding demeanor, all of which suited him quite well indeed. No longer the tortured and tentative adolescent I had recruited in our school days.
He was, without a doubt, *grown.* It was just — he looked so *miserable* on top of it all. More miserable than his gothic couture required. More miserable than I remembered, and the last things I remembered were... pretty bad. I was loathe to admit it, and would deny it elsewhere, but I was sorry to see him like this.
I could have brought him back to his Cokeworth hovel to interrogate — I mean, to *tend, * but I didn't want to spend any more time in *that* place. My one disastrous visit to Spinner's End — almost a decade before — had been more than enough for me.

Scene of the Crime by rachels_memories

Liz giving Jane an important little history lesson.

images.alt:
She stumbled in her thoughts, slowing down to catch me up. “You know what a wellspring is, right?”

I nodded. “The fountains that fill our world with magic.”

“Close enough! So…” Liz collects herself, thinking about where to begin. “Back before the dark age, an ancient people created a way to tap directly into those ‘fountains.’ Ambros swore that it was our ancestors, but I think that was just their ego talking. We don’t actually know who they were. What we do know, is that they used a form of magitech, very different from what modern day Ambros used, to funnel and store that magic.”

“Store it? Like in batteries?”

“Exactly. Believe it or not, the Anthosian batteries we use today are created using that same ancient technology at a facility right above their wellspring, just south of Vizthara. And from that facility, there’s a tunnel that leads to the capital, supplying the city with magic directly. So, if there’s a wellspring tunnel here, then it was probably once used to do the same, supplying magic to where it needed to go. This is exactly the leverage I was looking for.”

posts.author: Matt G's Bunker
posts.body:
Giant Anteater. 

One of South America's iconic insectivorous xenarthran mammals, as they're known to feast both on ants and termites.

(Updated from 2024)

💙/🔄s are welcomed! 🐜

#artistonbsky #as05 #humanart #wildlifeart #digitalart

images.alt:
A male Giant Anteater strolls along in the South American Grasslands as a new day approached. Nearby in the background there's termite mounds, trees, and plants to soldify the vegetation of what's currently the grasslands of Brazil. 

For such an iconic insectivorous mammals who walks on their front knuckles, the giant anteater uses it's knuckles to help dig up termites in the termite mounds, and with their elongated snouts, they have a long tongue to help eat the termites and ants to collect them by dozens. 

Their offspring is notably carried on the backs of their mothers, which they'll remain to do so until they're old enough to survive on their own.

Nowadays, the giant anteater is considered vulnerable thanks to them coming across human conflict especially when crossing roads developed on their habitat. 

Nevertheless, this artwork was challenging to get right, but I hope I did enough to make the anteater at least much more appealing compared to how I drew it two years earlier.

Nor does he have good answers for these questions.

#WIPSnips #WriteSky #WritingCommunity #WritingPrompts

images.alt:
Slipping inside, T’orrin closed the door quietly behind him. And turned around to find two men in guard uniforms watching him intently. Perhaps he was wrong about his luck.
	“Well, well, well,” the first man stepped forward, “we were told to watch for people sneaking out of the city, not in. But this works just as well.”
	“I have no idea what you are talking about,” T’orrin stammered. “We are just cutting through our friends’ house, on our way back from hunting in the woods. We do it all the time. Just ask them.”
	“Hunting, eh?” The second man sneered. “Where is your game, then?”
	“Not my lucky day.”
	“And your weapons?”
	“Left them in the woods.”
	“And her shoes?” He nodded towards the woman’s bare, bleeding feet. 
	T’orrin hesitated. He didn’t have an answer for that one. It didn’t really matter anyway, because it was obvious that they weren’t buying his story. 
	The first guard stepped closer and pushed back the woman’s hood.

Hadrian stood up, stretching. “If it helps you make peace, Riven cried when I told her. Well, she more than cried. She screamed and threw things at me. A couple of them were things I liked, too.” He laughed. “She might think you’re Antony, otherwise I don’t know why she would fucking care so much.”

I'm guessing I'm not the only academic spending their weekend frantically finalising teaching materials for next week (solidarity). As I plot out the assessment schedule using Excel, I am reminded of one of my favourite memes of all time...

#AcademicSky

images.alt: From AI: The famous internet meme is a chaotic Venn diagram featuring three overlapping circles: Incel, Microsoft Excel, and "me eating a fig."The Core JokeThe Intersection: The central punchline where all three circles overlap is incorrectly assuming something is a date.Excel constantly mistakes normal numbers, fractions, or codes (like 01-03 or gene identifiers) for calendar dates and auto-formats them.Incels (involuntary celibates) are stereotypically known for misinterpreting basic, polite friendliness from a woman or acquaintance as a romantic date."Me eating a fig" represents the literal mistake of mistaking a fig for a date (the dried fruit) at the market.Other Layered Jokes in the DiagramSheets that are never clean: Excel spreadsheets get messy with bad data, incels are stereotypically stereotyped as having poor hygiene/dirty bedsheets, and eating a fig can get messy.Dying gasp of wasps: Wild figs are pollinated by female wasps that occasionally get trapped and die inside the fruit, tying into the bizarre absurdism of the meme.

Text: Dr. Ben Tofflemire is a Pipeline Scientist for NASA’s Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) mission at the SETI Institute. He helps manage and develop the Science Processing Operations Center (SPOC) pipeline at NASA Ames Research Center, where observations from TESS are processed and transformed into exoplanet candidates. Background: Starry night sky with graphics of a star and exoplanets in front of it.

Text: His research also explores how stars and planets form and evolve, with a particular focus on young planetary systems less than 300 million years old. Dr. Tofflemire uses observations from facilities including TESS, ALMA, and the James Webb Space Telescope to study young stars, planet-forming disks, and the processes that shape emerging planetary systems. posts.author: James Brady
posts.body: Hell yeah, been waiting for this one. The latest in classic manga horror from @livingtheline.bsky.social's Smudge imprint: Mother, Please Don't Give Birth to a Monster by Shirakawa Marina #mangasky #booksky

images.alt: The cover of Mother, Please Don't Give Birth to a Monster by Shirakawa Marina. Other books from Smudge are above it.

A list of every Smudge imprint release stacked on top of eachother, from the bottom up: Her Frankenstein by Kawashima Norikazu, UFO Mushroom Invasion by Shirakawa Marina, Mansect by Koga Shinichi, Face Meat by Bonten Taro, My Gorilla Family by Iijima Ichiro, The Girl Who Raised The Dead by Norikazu, Hide and Seek by Naono Yoshiko and Mother, Please Don't Give Birth to a Monster by Marina.

The back of Mother, Please Don't Give Birth to a Monster by Shirakawa Marina. It reads:

"MOOOO! Lady Momon cries out, ready for her meal. MOOO! Baby sister bleasts, cold and miserable.

As a teenager, sweet Miki learns the bizarre truth about her family: for centuries, they have harnessed half-cow, half-human beasts known as "kudan" for their wealth and power. And soon, another shall be born. The hour approaches. Her mother moans in pain as the contractions begin. All poor Miki can do is plead, MOTHER, PLEASE DON'T GIVE BIRTH TO A MONSTER!

Published in 1988 at the end of horror manga's classic era, MOTHER, PLEASE DON'T GIVE BIRTH TO A MONSTER is a revoltingly zany tour de force by the incomparable Shirakawa Marina. Never before reissued even in Japan, this graphic novel is the culmination of Shirakawa's crackpot synthesis of Japanese history, folklore, and the occulat, as made famous by his UFO MUSHROOM INVASION. With an essay exploring Shirakawa's obsession with prophecy and the apocalypse, MOTHER, PLEASE DON'T GIVE BIRTH A MONSTER is the eighth volume of SMUDGE, a line of vintage horror and dark fantasy manga curated by award-winning historian Ryan Holmberg and published by Living the Line.

🔬 𝗜𝘀 𝗮 𝗴𝗮𝗽 𝗯𝗲𝘁𝘄𝗲𝗲𝗻 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗿𝘂𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗻𝗼𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗮 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗼𝘂𝘁?

Same 30 nm gold particles: 24.9 nm by AFM, 28.6 nm by DLS. That gap is physics.
61 labs, one isotherm: 1,757 to 9,341 m²/g. That gap is analysis.

Values are representative.

#ChemSky #MaterialsScience #AcademicSky

images.alt: Chart titled One sample, three kinds of disagreement. Three panels. Physics: the same nominal 30 nm gold particles measured by six techniques on a 24 to 28 nm scale give AFM 24.9, SAXS 24.9, SEM 26.9 and TEM 27.6 for the particle itself, then ES-DMA 28.4 and DLS 28.6 for how it moves. Setup: eight TEM labs on the same particles vary by 2.6% on the mean size but 14.8% on the width of the distribution; in one lab 79% of imaged particles stood alone for automatic analysis. Analysis: sixty-one labs fitting the same isotherm for one MOF reported 1,757 to 9,341 square metres per gram, a factor of 5.3; all 18 isotherms spread by at least 300. Cards read Keep it, Record it and Write the rule down. A dark bar says a model sees one number per sample unless each row says which instrument asked which question. Footer: Before pooling results, separate the physics from the setup.

posts.author: Andrew Sissons
posts.body:
The UK government is designing a new scheme for upgrading heating and energy in low income households, to replace ECO (which had a lot of issues).

How can government get the new scheme right? We’ve set out Nesta’s view here:
www.nesta.org.uk/report/nesta...

images.alt:
The ten building blocks that make up an effective low-income scheme

A diagram titled 'The ten building blocks that make up an effective low-income scheme'. The ten building blocks are organised into four categorised columns:

User centricity: Providing a joined-up consumer experience and supporting households to benefit long term.
Appropriate measures: Deciding which measures and funding homes get, unlocking investment in local economies, and determining how to distribute funding fairly and effectively.
Ability and flexibility: Enabling each local scheme to respond to local needs through devolution, identifying and including households in need, and building the capabilities needed to deliver everywhere.
Do things well: Providing strong guarantees and long-term support and delivering high-quality, effective upgrades to homes.

posts.author: Patrick Johanneson 🚀 🇨🇦
posts.body:
#WIPSnips Sept. 28: "prime"

#WriteSky #WritingCommunity #WritingPrompts #PrairieSFF

images.alt:
She took a deep breath, held it a few seconds, let it out. Again, and again. She remembered her father, teaching her and her brother George how to swim, telling them that this was the way to prime yourself for a long submersion, that it would help your lungs get every atom of oxygen they could. Who knew if it was true. One more deep breath. 

Holding her eyes open, she plunged under the water again.

She dove through layers of colour: at first the water was clear, then bluish, glassy green, and—at the limits of her air—brown. She passed beyond the point of no return, kicking hard, lungs burning. She wanted to gasp, to take a breath, but the water was still all around her, darkening, darker now than the indigo above. She was aware that she had made a mistake, that she was still making that mistake, and that it was perhaps the last mistake she had left.

Sorry, Edwin.

Was the water darkening, or was her vision?

posts.body:
This week’s image is of NGC 7253! Captured by Gemini’s GMOS-N, this dramatic scene between the two galaxies is also known as Nā ʻUhane Māhoe Huki Pū i ke Ola (“The twin spirits pulling together creating life”). Check out the 🧵 for another paper.

#Astronomy
📸 in thread

images.alt: An image of NGC 7253, a pair of interacting spiral galaxies set against a dark background scattered with distant stars and galaxies. The galaxy on the left is angled slightly, displaying a bright, glowing core and sprawling spiral arms heavily dotted with bright pink and blue regions of star formation. The galaxy on the right is viewed nearly edge-on, looking like an elongated, warped streak of light stretching toward the first galaxy. A luminous haze of gas, dust, and stars appears to connect the two structures, illustrating the intense gravitational pull between them.

From 1975, Joy of Cooking

EGGS FOOYOUNG WITH SHRIMP

Fooyoung is really a rich omelet made with additions of cooked vegetables, fish and meat.

Clean or drain:

2 cups bean sprouts

Heat:
A little vegetable oil
in a skillet and stir-fry, until translucent and
crisp:

1 minced slice gingerroot
6 chopped green onions
1 rib celery, thinly sliced
1 cup chopped cooked fish, shrimp or finely
diced cooked meat

Have ready and combine the above ingredients
and the sprouts with:

6 well-beaten eggs
1 teaspoon salt
½ teaspoon pepper

Heat an additional:

1 tablespoon vegetable oil

in another small skillet. Drop the above mixture
into it to form small omelets, golden brown on
both sides. Serve with:

Soy sauce

posts.author: PLOS Biology
posts.body:
How do herbivorous insects coordinate detoxification pathways to counter plant defenses and diversify host use? This study identifies a pathway driving furanocoumarin detoxification in Helicoverpa, providing insights into toxin tolerance and host range variation.
🧪 #AcademicSky
buff.ly/6LxF1gl

images.alt:
Comparative schematic of the CYP6AE19–UGT33 detoxification cascade mediating xanthotoxin metabolism in H. armigera and H. assulta.
In H. armigera, dietary xanthotoxin is efficiently metabolised through a sequential Phase I–Phase II pathway. CYP6AE19 first catalyses O-dealkylation to produce xanthotoxol or aromatic-ring hydroxylation to generate 5-hydroxyxanthotoxin. These hydroxyl-containing intermediates are then glucosylated by UGT33 enzymes to form xanthotoxol glucoside and 5-hydroxyxanthotoxin glucoside, thereby increasing their hydrophilicity and promoting detoxification. In H. assulta, HsCYP6AE19 lacks detectable activity towards xanthotoxin, and only a subset of HsUGT33 enzymes show weak glucosylation activity towards xanthotoxol and 5-hydroxyxanthotoxin, indicating attenuation of this coordinated P450–UGT detoxification cascade.

F: 0 1 * 3 4 3 2 0 1 1 1
G: 1 2 2 * 2 * 1 0 1 * 2

QUICK TOMATO SOUP

About 4 Cups
→ Simmer, covered, 15 minutes:
2½ cups canned tomatoes
¼ cup sliced onion
½ cup chopped celery with leaves

Strain and reserve the tomato stock. Melt:
2 tablespoons butter

Add and stir until blended:
2 tablespoons flour

Add, cook and stir until smooth and boiling:

2 cups Brown Stock, or canned bouillon
½ teaspoon sugar
⅛ teaspoon paprika
The strained tomato stock
Season to taste

and add, just before serving:

dollop of whipped cream)

posts.author: SETI Institute
posts.body:
#PPOD: How small can something form like a star?

JWST has found brown dwarfs in IC 348 with only about twice Jupiter’s mass—the least massive brown dwarfs known. Their existence challenges models of how stars and brown dwarfs form. 🧪 🔭

images.alt: A star-forming region. It is blanketed in thick clouds of gas and dust, millions of kilometres across, that form swirling patterns. Bright stars are scattered throughout the clouds, with the densest cluster situated in the centre of the scene. Each is crowned with six long points created by the optics of the telescope’s mirrors. In the upper right, a couple of hidden stars blast out long, glowing jets of material.

posts.author: ESA Space Science
posts.body:
Earth and Venus may have started out as near twins, but today one is full of life and the other is a scorching greenhouse world 🌋

ESA's Envision launches in 2031 to find out why they turned out so differently.

Discover more here 👉 esa.int/envision 🔭

images.alt: An image of Earth and Venus on a black background, with the Envision spacecraft in the foreground. The left half of Venus shows what it looks like from space, enshrouded in a thick cloud cover (image by NASA's Mariner 10 spacecraft), while the right half shows a map of the surface terrain as reconstructed from radar data recorded by NASA's Magellan mission.
